posts.hook: Anthropic's cheapest model has a price cliff built in
posts.caption: anthropic released claude haiku 5.5 with a fivefold price step past 100k tokens, openai split gpt-6 in chatgpt into sol and luna by plan, four states sued tp-link over router security claims. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 costs $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens, until prompts pass 100K
slides.desc: Past that the price jumps ==fivefold==, so long-context work is cheaper elsewhere.

slides.title: GPT-6 in ChatGPT now runs on Sol for paid plans and Luna for free ones
slides.desc: The same prompt can get visibly different quality depending on what you pay.

slides.title: Tensorlake's npm package was hit by a worm that punishes revocation
slides.desc: A hostage token wipes the machine if revoked, so isolate first, then rotate.

terms.gloss: the main package registry javascript developers download code from

slides.title: Four states sue TP-Link over router security and China ties
slides.desc: TP-Link denies it, and the FCC ban still has no exemption for it.

terms.gloss: the us regulator for radio and telecom equipment

slides.title: Microsoft's $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra targets local AI with 128GB shared memory
slides.desc: It ships October 16 and skips a discrete GPU.

posts.hook: Google wants its AI to work for days, not one chat turn
posts.caption: google cloud unveiled a gemini agent for multi-day workflows, anthropic committed $150m in claude access to 15 us science agencies, openai disrupted a russian influence campaign. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Google Cloud unveils a Gemini agent for multi-day enterprise workflows
slides.desc: It spans Workspace, Microsoft 365 and Slack, so ==assistant becomes coworker==.

slides.title: Anthropic commits $150M in Claude access to 15 US science agencies
slides.desc: Credits for Claude and Claude Code reach scientists at NASA, NIH and NSF over three years.

slides.title: OpenAI says it disrupted a Russian influence campaign aimed at schools and media
slides.desc: It rates it 5 of 6 on impact, the most far-reaching it has stopped.

slides.title: Arena, the AI leaderboard company, raised $200M at a $3.1B valuation
slides.desc: Up from $1.7B in January: model rankings are now a venture-backed business.
